The '''House of Tion''' was an ancient and powerful noble family from the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

==History==
{{Quote|We've gathered more intel on the rakghoul outbreak. Things are getting worse. The Tion noble family has quarantined all worlds in the sector--no ships can land or leave without permission.|[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Rannos]]|<ref name="TOR:OinTH">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Outbreak in the Tion Hegemony|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
The House of Tion already existed at the time of the [[Xim Wars]] when the head of the family, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Pre-Republic era Lord)|Tion]], was acquainted with [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="XaV" />

Millennia later, the House of Tion ruled the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] as a royal family.<ref name="TOR:TMTH" /> Despite intense rivalry with the [[Thirty-seven Families]] of [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]],<ref name="TOR:KUS" /> the family administered the region for centuries<ref name="TOR:TMTH" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], both factions negotiated with the House of Tion in order to obtain the support of the rich Tion Hegemony in the conflict.<ref name="TOR:OinTH" /><ref name="TOR:TinTH">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Trouble in the Tion Hegemony|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref> In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the exiled [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]], unleashed a [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] in the the Tion Hegemony in order to take revenge on the royal family. As the Hegemony descended into chaos, the Tion royal family reluctantly accepted help from the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire to deal with the situation and eventually [[Mission to the Lost Island|eliminate]] Lorrick.<ref name="TOR:OinTH" /><ref name="TOR:TinTH" />

Later during the Galactic War, a [[House of Tion tomb]] was excavated.<ref name="TOR:DID">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Death's Intricate Door}}</ref> At some point during the Cold War, the [[Livien civil war]] broke out, with Rebel factions warring against the House of Tion.<ref name="UT">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Overthrowing the Tyrants}}</ref>

The House of Tion still existed at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_4.html|New Xim Exhibit to Tour}}</ref> However, the Tion Hegemony had already lost all of its former glory at that time and was only known as a remote backwater region.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The House of Tion therefore funded the [[Allied Tion Historical Society]] in order to promote the rich history and legacy of the Tion Hegemony.<ref name="HNN47" /> During the Clone Wars, the young [[Nenevanth Tion]], a member of the House of Tion, joined the [[SAGroup (COMPOR)/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] of the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]].<ref name="Insider 70">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref>
